## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] The change matches the related issue and stays within the CRUD MVP scope.
- [ ] Only files owned by the author were modified, or changes to others' files were coordinated.
- [ ] Shared JSON schemas / API contracts are respected (or changes were agreed).
- [ ] No API keys, secrets, `.env` files, or credentials are included.
- [ ] No unnecessary files (`node_modules/`, virtual environments, caches, build output).
- [ ] Code and documentation are clear and readable.
- [ ] Testing is described and is adequate for the change.
- [ ] The branch is up to date with `main` and has no merge conflicts.
